column1: # exe_maps/psp-eu.tsv - where BOF3.exe's initialised data is in this build, by bytes.
# Generated by tools/exe_twins.py map (docs/exe-tables-by-build.md); do not edit.
# Addresses and counts only (CLAUDE.md rule 1). One line per segment: the PC range
# [pc, pc_end) is the build's `file` (BOOT = the boot EXE, BOOT.BIN = the PSP ELF;
# else an EMI and its section) from `addr` on; `agree` bytes of it were compared
# equal (pointer words wild), the rest are gaps of at most 64 bytes between them.
# `copies`: how many files hold the seed at that address (an overlay copied into many).
# A segment of one table placed by a search or by its neighbours' displacement
# rather than by a run says so in `how` (`name`: several places held it equally and
# the file its symbol's name names was taken - the weakest).
